title: Drum Machine Designer Tricks
intro: Drum Machine Designer is built on a Track Stack: every pad you fill gets its own subtrack and channel strip, so each drum sound can be processed on its own in the Mixer.

tips.t: Drag any audio file straight onto a pad
tips.d: Drag a WAV, AIFF or MP3 from the Finder or a Logic Pro browser, or a region from the Tracks area, onto a pad to add it to your kit. When you drop a region onto a pad, Drum Machine Designer inserts a new Quick Sampler instance on a new subtrack.

src.label: Apple — Create and customize Drum Machine Designer kits in Logic Pro for Mac

tips.t: Every pad is its own channel strip
tips.d: Open the Mixer with X and you will see each pad as a separate channel inside the stack. Compress the snare, saturate the kick, send only the claps to reverb.

tips.d: To copy a pad, Control-click it and choose Copy. Then Control-click the pad you want to replace and choose Paste. Cut works the same way. Dragging a pad to an empty location in the grid reorders it rather than copying it.

src.label: Apple — Use Drum Machine Designer pad controls in Logic Pro for Mac

tips.t: Use Pad Controls for quick shaping
tips.d: Select a pad and click Pad Controls in the bar below the grid. The pad's tone and effect parameters appear in the Plug-in pane. For Quick Sampler pads, Q-Sampler Main shows the waveform editor and Q-Sampler Details shows the LFOs and the pitch, filter and amp envelopes. Drum Synth pads get a Drum Synth button.

tips.t: Use the main track for the whole kit
tips.d: A Drum Machine Designer kit is a track stack. Plug-ins on its main track affect every subtrack, so put your kit compressor and limiter there. Any pad whose output you route outside the stack skips that processing.

tips.t: Save your kit as a patch
tips.d: In Drum Machine Designer, select the kit name pad at the top so you save the complete kit, then click Save at the bottom of the Library. A summing-stack patch can include the main track and all subtracks, along with their channel strip and plug-in settings.
